Messages.Body:
Howdy All,

When does damage from Weather Control resolve? If one or more of the
combatants has enough Weather Control damage pending to torporize them
before range is determined, will the combat end before range is
determined? Or will there still be 'Determine Range' and 'Strike'
phases, after which the damage will be resolved, along with any
additional combat damage?

In the former case, I'm pretty sure you can use Skin of Night to convert
Weather Control damage aggravated by a Dawn Op to normal (though
unpreventable) damage, but can you Taste (if you are not heading to
torpor yourself)? That is, given that you haven't gotten to the
'Strike' phase of combat, can you play a card that is playable 'after
strike resolution'? Or is what happened after you played the Weather
Control a strike resolution?

OK, my brain hurts now,
Alex

http://www.deja.com/

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
alex.br...@clearband.com wrote:
> When does damage from Weather Control resolve? If one or more of the

Before range is determined (each round).

> combatants has enough Weather Control damage pending to torporize them
> before range is determined, will the combat end before range is
> determined? Or will there still be 'Determine Range' and 'Strike'

Yes.

> phases, after which the damage will be resolved, along with any
> additional combat damage?

No. Combat ends as soon as a combatant is no longer ready.

>
> In the former case, I'm pretty sure you can use Skin of Night to
> convert
> Weather Control damage aggravated by a Dawn Op to normal (though

Yes.

> unpreventable) damage, but can you Taste (if you are not heading to
> torpor yourself)? That is, given that you haven't gotten to the
> 'Strike' phase of combat, can you play a card that is playable 'after
> strike resolution'? Or is what happened after you played the Weather

No. A card that is playable only after strike resolution cannot
be played before stike resolution.

> Control a strike resolution?

Weather Control's damage doesn't wait for strike resolution.
